module.purpose: Provides a Vue composable hook for reactive, live database queries with automatic subscription management and status tracking.
module.summary: This file implements a Vue 3 composable hook `useLiveQuery` that bridges TanStack DB's reactive querying system with Vue's reactivity model. It supports multiple calling patterns: passing a query builder function, a configuration object, or a pre-created query collection. The hook returns reactive computed properties for data, state, and various status flags (loading, ready, idle, error, cleaned-up). It handles subscription lifecycle management, automatic cleanup on component unmount, and synchronization between the underlying collection and Vue's reactive state.
module.businessContext: Enables Vue components to declaratively query and reactively display database data with proper loading/error states. Critical for real-time applications where data changes must be reflected in the UI without manual polling.
functions: useLiveQuery (~L119-305): Main composable hook implementation with collection lifecycle management

detail.name: useLiveQuery
detail.signature: export function useLiveQuery<TResult extends object, TKey extends string | number, TUtils extends Record<string, any>>(liveQueryCollection: MaybeRefOrGetter<Collection<TResult, TKey, TUtils> & NonSingleResult>): UseLiveQueryReturnWithCollection<TResult, TKey, TUtils>
preconditions: The input must be one of: a function query builder, a config object for createLiveQueryCollection, or a pre-created Collection instance
If deps are provided, each element must be a value, ref, or getter that can be resolved via toValue
postconditions: Returns an object with reactive data, status, collection, isLoading, isError, isReady, and state properties
The collection's sync is started (or already running) before returning
data reflects the current collection contents as a reactive array (or single item for singleResult collections)
status is a reactive ref tracking the collection's sync status ('disabled' when no collection)
invariants: The internal data array maintains the same order as the underlying collection's values()
A watchEffect subscribes to collection changes and unsubscribes on invalidation or collection change
Only one active subscription exists at a time (previous subscription is cleaned up on collection change)
edgeCases: Input is a function that returns null/undefined: a special __DISABLED_QUERY__ error is thrown internally, caught, and the collection is set to null with status 'disabled'
Input is a pre-created collection with status 'idle': startSyncImmediate() is called automatically
Input is a pre-created collection with config.syncMode === 'on-demand': a console.warn is emitted explaining that no data will load without predicates
Input parameter is a non-function value where toValue fails (try/catch): the original parameter is used as-is
Input parameter is a function: toValue is NOT called on it (functions are treated as query builders, not getters)
When the computed collection resolves to null (disabled query): status is set to 'disabled', state is cleared, data array is emptied, and any active subscription is unsubscribed

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: If createLiveQueryCollection throws due to null/undefined query return, returns null (disabled state); other errors are re-thrown
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: null when the query builder function returns null or undefined (disabled query)

stateMutations: reactive Map 'state' — cleared when collection becomes null
reactive Array 'internalData' — repopulated on every collection change to reflect current values
ref 'status' — updated to reflect collection sync status or 'disabled'
computed 'data' — derived from internalData; returns single item or array based on singleResult
computed 'collection' — derived from unwrapped input parameter
Subscription cleanup variable 'currentUnsubscribe' — set/unset on watchEffect invalidation
detail.summary: Vue composable that wraps a live query (config, query function, or pre-created collection) into a reactive object exposing data, status, collection, and loading/error states, automatically starting sync and subscribing to granular change updates.

specLiterals.value:
[useLiveQuery] Warning: Passing a collection with syncMode "on-demand" directly to useLiveQuery will not load any data. In on-demand mode, data is only loaded when queries with predicates request it.

Instead, use a query builder function:
  const { data } = useLiveQuery((q) => q.from({ c: myCollection }).select(({ c }) => c))

Or switch to syncMode "eager" if you want all data to sync automatically.
specLiterals.role: Diagnostic warning message contractually emitted when a collection with on-demand syncMode is passed directly
